question: independent_attack.py passes max_tokens=1600, but the durable R523 gauntlet failure records say finish_reason=length, max_tokens=2048. Which budget was actually used?
verdict: BOTH numbers are true. They describe different attempts of the SAME generate() call. The durable record reports the ESCALATED budget, not the call-site budget.

mechanism.escalation: discovery_fabric/engine/llm_registry.py:2142-2160 (EmptyContentWithFinish rescue): below-ceiling empty content retries the SAME provider/model with attempt_budget = min(reasoning_retry_ceiling, attempt_budget*4)
mechanism.zai_ceiling: zai reasoning_retry_ceiling = 2048 (dataclass default; verified from _SPEC_BY_ID at 5d28cfd4)
sequence: attempt 1 (zai, max_tokens=1600): empty content at finish_reason=length -> rescue escalation, NOT durably recorded (retry_notes only, ephemeral)
attempt 2 (zai, max_tokens=2048): empty content at finish_reason=length -> at-ceiling, R514 skips identical retry, cascade advances
ONE durable hop line records the exhausted rung: attempt=2, error text carries max_tokens=2048

wall_attribution_consequence.recorded_hop_wall: llm_registry.py:2291 records latency_ms from hop_t0, which is set BEFORE the attempt loop (line 2035) - so the durable ~170-285 s gauntlet walls aggregate BOTH the unrecorded 1600 attempt AND the recorded 2048 attempt, plus the 2 s backoff sleep
wall_attribution_consequence.per_attempt_split: UNKNOWN - not durably recorded. The durable bytes cannot separate the 1600-attempt wall from the 2048-attempt wall.
wall_attribution_consequence.same_pattern: POST_RANK_TECH_IMPROVEMENT zai failures at max_tokens=3000 had ceiling 3000? No - technical_state passes 3000 > ceiling 2048, so NO escalation occurred there: both zai attempts ran at the call-site 3000 (at-ceiling from the start, R514 cascade). The 257.8 s and 817.5 s walls are clean single-attempt walls.

ruling: Do NOT use '2048 token cap' as an optimization fact or causal variable - the failing gauntlet call BEGAN at 1600 and the durable record cannot split the two attempts' walls.
Do NOT change token budget in R524 - budget is a second hypothesis and would destroy the one-intervention discipline.
A budget experiment, if ever authorized, must FIRST durably instrument per-attempt walls (a measurement-layer change, recorded), and only then vary the budget.
